title: Terminate all instances of a process by name
summary: Use killall to send a termination signal to every running instance of a specific program. This is useful when an application freezes or you want to close all windows of an app at once.

steps.explain: Send the default SIGTERM signal to all processes matching the exact name. This asks the application to close gracefully.

placeholders.name: PROCESS_NAME
placeholders.description: The exact name of the process to terminate (e.g., firefox, chrome, code).

alternatives.explain: Ask for confirmation before killing each process instance.
